content.content:
# Northfield Term Sheet - Summary and Open Points

**Prepared for:** Aleks Varga, Maya Chen, Dana Whitaker (Granite Peak Capital)
**Source:** Northfield Ventures term sheet received Sep 22 from Ravi Menon. Plain-English summary; counsel's markup is the controlling document.

## Headline terms

| Term | Northfield proposal | Our position |
|---|---|---|
| Round size | $38M Series B preferred | Accept |
| Valuation | $210M post-money | Accept |
| Lead allocation | Northfield up to $32M | Accept |
| Existing investors | Granite Peak pro-rata (~$6M) | Accept, confirmed by Dana |
| Liquidation preference | 1x non-participating | Accept |
| Board | Northfield takes one seat (Ravi Menon); board becomes 5 | Accept, want independent seat preserved |
| Option pool | Refresh to 12% of post, counted in pre-money | Negotiate |
| Pro-rata rights | Major investors only (>$2M) | Accept |
| Information rights | Monthly financials, annual budget, quarterly board pack | Push monthly to quarterly |
| No-shop | 45 days | Accept |
| Target close | Nov 14 | Accept |

## Dilution, rough

At $210M post with a $38M raise, new money is about 18.1% of the company. If the 12% pool refresh sits entirely in the pre-money, founders and existing holders absorb it. Jordan's model: an 8% refresh covers the Hiring Plan - Post Series B plus a VP Engineering grant with room for 2027 refreshes. 12% is more than we need.

## Conditions to close

- Confirmatory diligence: legal, financial, commercial, technical, compliance
- Technical diligence led by Elena Sorensen (Northfield's advisor, former CTO). Date TBD; Northfield suggested mid-October.
- Satisfactory review of the Pillar Bank relationship, including the sponsor agreement and any open regulatory items
- SOC 2 status letter covering the Type I report and the Type II window

## Open points

Open question: Option pool at 12% versus 8%. Jordan to send the model to Ravi; Aleks to negotiate.

Open question: Monthly financial reporting. Fine operationally (we produce it anyway), but we'd rather not commit to monthly board-grade packs. Ask for monthly management accounts plus quarterly board packs.

Open question: Does Northfield want a key-person clause on Maya and Aleks? Not in the term sheet; Ravi mentioned it verbally. We'd resist.

Timing of the technical diligence call relative to the Oct 21 board meeting is also open. Better before, so the board sees a clean diligence readout.

## What Northfield is underwriting

From Ravi's partner memo summary (shared verbally):
- Investing live in Q4 with a credible adoption curve from the beta
- Money movement that doesn't break again after April 6
- A VP Engineering hire within two quarters of close
- SOC 2 Type II report in early 2027

Risk: Investing GA slipping into November undercuts the first point. Renee Alvarez's go/no-go #1 is Sep 29.

Risk: Any new money-movement incident during diligence reopens the April 6 conversation.

## Next steps

- [x] Aleks: counter on option pool and information rights by 2026-09-25
- [x] Jordan: pool sizing model to Ravi Menon by 2026-09-25
- [x] Aleks: sign term sheet by 2026-09-25 (signed; pool settled at 10%)
- [x] Maya: confirm technical diligence date with Elena Sorensen by 2026-09-30 (set for Oct 14)
- [x] Jordan: financial diligence index to Northfield by 2026-10-02

**Oct 2 addendum:** Ravi Menon asked how the Sep 26 duplicate round-up debits relate to the April 6 outage. Maya answered in writing the same day; the full log of diligence asks now lives in Series B - Process Tracker.

Decision: Accept $38M at $210M post with Northfield as lead; pool refresh settled at 10% (Aleks, Sep 25).
